title: folder création with thunderbird mobile
creator: michel_mno
content:
Two questions, specific to mobile version (no problem with Linux laptop version)

  • how to create a folder and subfolder on an imap account ?
  • how to mask subfolders (created by other mean) by default ? But to display only in parent vient.

title: Show recipient in folder after moving sent mail
creator: nigelmay
content:
When I send a mail, the sent folder logically shows the recipient. However, if I move a sent mail into, say, a client folder, all I have is a very user-unfriendly header that shows that I sent the mail. Not a lot of help when I move many mails into client folders. There doesn't seem to be an option anywhere to change this.

On PC thunderbird I can remove the "from" column as I know it's from me, and show the "recipient" column. Is this possible on the mobile version of TB?
